name: Template: Legal & Compliance
description: Track contracts, policy requests, and compliance reviews. Each swimlane is a department; each card is a request or obligation.

swimlanes.name: Engineering
swimlanes.notes: Open-source license reviews, vendor DPAs, API partner agreements.

swimlanes.name: Finance
swimlanes.notes: Vendor contracts, payment processor agreements, financial compliance filings.

swimlanes.name: HR & People
swimlanes.notes: Employment agreements, contractor agreements, equity plan reviews, HR policy updates.

swimlanes.name: Sales & Customer Contracts
swimlanes.notes: Customer MSAs, DPAs, BAAs, SLAs, order forms. Average turn time: 5 business days.

swimlanes.name: Product & Engineering Policy
swimlanes.notes: Privacy policy, ToS, cookie policy, AI policy, acceptable use policy.
